lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Supplier qualification SQ-2012-007 - Kessler-Ondra Harze GmbH, KO-Epox 410
Material: modified low-crystallisation liquid epoxy resin KO-Epox 410 LC, for EF-210 Part
Tests: 6 freeze-thaw cycles (-10 °C / +25 °C): no crystallisation. Reference ALTAREP
EEW 188 g/eq; viscosity at 25 °C 9,800 mPa·s; EF-210 trial batches within specification.
Conclusion: approved; replaces ALTAREP E-19 from May 2012.
